audit.query: SELECT 'categorias' AS campo, e.processing_status, count(*) AS elementos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS DISTINCT FROM lower(v)) AS nao_minusculos FROM public.estampas e CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(e.categorias) v GROUP BY e.processing_status UNION ALL SELECT 'elementos_visuais' AS campo, e.processing_status, count(*) AS elementos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS DISTINCT FROM lower(v)) AS nao_minusculos FROM public.estampas e CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(e.elementos_visuais) v GROUP BY e.processing_status UNION ALL SELECT 'ocasioes' AS campo, e.processing_status, count(*) AS elementos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS DISTINCT FROM lower(v)) AS nao_minusculos FROM public.estampas e CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(e.ocasioes) v GROUP BY e.processing_status UNION ALL SELECT 'publicos_sugeridos' AS campo, e.processing_status, count(*) AS elementos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS DISTINCT FROM lower(v)) AS nao_minusculos FROM public.estampas e CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(e.publicos_sugeridos) v GROUP BY e.processing_status UNION ALL SELECT 'contextos_uso' AS campo, e.processing_status, count(*) AS elementos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS DISTINCT FROM lower(v)) AS nao_minusculos FROM public.estampas e CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(e.contextos_uso) v GROUP BY e.processing_status UNION ALL SELECT 'afinidades_visuais' AS campo, e.processing_status, count(*) AS elementos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS DISTINCT FROM lower(v)) AS nao_minusculos FROM public.estampas e CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(e.afinidades_visuais) v GROUP BY e.processing_status UNION ALL SELECT 'padroes_texteis' AS campo, e.processing_status, count(*) AS elementos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v IS DISTINCT FROM lower(v)) AS nao_minusculos FROM public.estampas e CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(e.padroes_texteis) v GROUP BY e.processing_status
